subject: Interim hardware bridge and burst-floor approval request — Nimbus Health renewal
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@nimbushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity ask: H100 allocation + overage terms for renewal

Ben —

Quick note from procurement after our renewal call this morning. We appreciate the renewal pricing but one technical requirement changed on our side: a subset of our inference workloads (image segmentation pipelines) have a validated dependency on the H100 topology for the next 12 weeks while we complete a model quantization pass. The contract we just discussed assumes the standard A100-class reservation.

Can Redwood:
- Hold/allocate a temporary pool of H100-equivalent capacity for Nimbus (estimated 12 weeks, peak 120 vGPU hours/day)
- Guarantee burst access to that pool when needed (we expect intermittent 2–6 hour spikes)
- Cap overage rates during the bridge period — procurement is requesting an overage-floor (e.g., no more than 1.6x standard overage) while we do the migration

We attached the workload profile and a draft SOW (Nimbus_DDL_Requirements.pdf). Procurement will need a written approval from Redwood leadership for non-standard SKU and a temporary overage-floor before countersignature. Can you advise next steps and timelines?

Best,
Emma Torres
Director, Cloud Ops — Nimbus Health
procurement@nimbushealth.com

[Attachment: Nimbus_DDL_Requirements.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Torres <emma@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference, aditya_rao@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask: H100 allocation + overage terms for renewal

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the profile. I can start the internal request but we will need an exception approval for both the hardware SKU and the overage-floor. Looping in Lauren and Aditya for deal desk + exec signoff.

My suggested practical options (so internal stakeholders have something concrete to review):
1) Temporary H100 allocation (12 weeks) — carved from a priority pool; reserved capacity remains A100 but we map a 20% slice to H100 for Nimbus in off-peak windows.
2) Burst access up to 50% of committed reserved throughput for 2–6 hr spikes
3) Overage-floor: cap overage to 1.6x standard overage rate for the 12-week bridge, with a review at week 8 (finance signoff required)
4) Modest one-time amendment fee to cover rebalancing and reservation hold costs (propose $12,500)

If we can get an executive signoff on the SKU exception + overage-floor + amendment fee, I will prepare a short amendment and DocuSign packet.

Attachments: proposed_amendment_v2.docx (draft terms)

-ben
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
+1 415-555-0129

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Capacity ask: H100 allocation + overage terms for renewal

Thanks for the context, Ben. I'm supportive of an interim accommodation to avoid losing the renewal, but we need tighter guardrails. A few points before we escalate to exec sign-off: 

- Business trade-offs: H100 is constrained; granting SKUs outside the standard reservation materially increases opportunity cost. We should require Nimbus to commit to a min-usage threshold during the 12 weeks (e.g., 60% of the carved pool) or reduce the bridge term to 8 weeks to mitigate risk.
- Pricing: I can approve a temporary overage-floor up to 1.5x standard if we take the $12.5k amendment fee and reduce the requested term to 8 weeks. Any longer or deeper discount needs VP-level signoff.
- Legal / billing: Legal needs to review the amendment wording (explicit term, auto-reversion to standard SKU, and audit rights). Finance — can we confirm the billing path for the amendment fee and how the cap is applied?

Ask for Exec: If Ben and Aditya agree to the adjusted terms (8-week bridge, 1.5x cap, $12.5k amendment), I will take this to VP for final sign-off today. If they prefer the full 12 weeks and 1.6x cap, we need a direct exec sign-off and a cc to Markus in finance for the risk acceptance.

-lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Capacity ask: H100 allocation + overage terms for renewal

Looping in since you mentioned finance. High level: finance can accept a controlled exposure with these constraints:
- Maximum bridge term: 8 weeks (we cannot underwrite 12 weeks without a revenue commitment)
- Overage cap: approve up to 1.5x standard overage for the bridge period
- Amendment fee: collect $12,500 up-front to cover rebalancing + potential third-party procurement fees
- Minimum utilization commitment: require Nimbus to use at least 60% of the carved H100 pool during the bridge; failure to meet this triggers a reconciliation for the delta (billable to Nimbus)

If sales accepts these constraints I will instruct billing to create the one-off sku mapping and to apply the capped overage logic for the agreed period. Legal still needs to clear the amendment language but finance is good on the numbers.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Torres <emma@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference, aditya_rao@redwood.inference, markus_klein@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Capacity ask: H100 allocation + overage terms for renewal — Proposed final terms

Emma — thanks for your patience. Per internal review, Redwood can accommodate a temporary H100 bridge under the following conditions (final terms):

- Term: 8 weeks from amendment effective date (auto-reverts to A100 reservation after expiry)
- Capacity: priority carved H100 pool sized to your profile (peak 120 vGPU hours/day)
- Burst access: up to 50% of committed reserved throughput for 2–6 hour spikes
- Overage-floor: capped at 1.5x our standard overage rate during the bridge period
- Amendment fee: $12,500, payable up-front
- Minimum utilization: Nimbus must consume >=60% of the carved H100 pool across the bridge; shortfalls will be reconciled at standard rates

I've attached the drafted amendment (proposed_amendment_v2.docx) and created a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/some-doc-link/ABC123. If Nimbus can countersign by close of business Friday (2027-06-11), we will schedule the H100 carve and update billing rules.

Let me know if procurement needs any clarifications. If you accept, I'll send the DocuSign and route to legal for the final check.

Thanks,
-ben
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_amendment_v2.docx]
